title: Shot contract
description: One shot of a chapter, the unit of work. Compile, render, QC and assembly are deterministic from it.

id.description: Chapter id, then the shot number: s1e3-sh01.

beat.description: The chapter beat this shot belongs to (decision of 3 Oct: cold open, verse, scene, reveal, question).

retention.description: What the shot does for retention. Hook, reveal and cliffhanger route to the premium model; stakes and connective to the cheaper one.

framing.description: Style bible section 7: medium_wide is the closest framing on any person; closer framings are for objects only (checked in code). insert is a macro on an object or hand.

setting.description: Place, time of day and light, as the model should see it.

blocking.description: Who is in frame, where, and what they do during the shot.

durationS.description: Seconds. Capped at the longest single take the routed models allow.

references.description: Asset-bible ids that condition the render: character sheets, location plates, objects, style.

claims.description: Rule 2: the canon claims this shot depicts. At least one.

forbidden.description: Rule 1: what the render must not show. Always carries deity_face_closeup and pov_inside_deity.

territory.description: Rule 4: where the output may be shown. Self-hosted MiniMax H3 is india_only.

quality.description: Rule 6: draft (480p) until edit lock; final needs a human approval record.

claimId.description: Text, book, chapter, verse: mbh.7.34.19. A whole chapter is mbh.7.33; a verse range ends -21.

referenceId.description: Kind, then name: char.abhimanyu, loc.kurukshetra, obj.chariot_wheel, style.relief_lamp.

witness.description: Rule 1: whose vantage the shot shares. Never a revered figure. Adding a witness is a decision in docs/decisions.md.
